<@&851447922301730836>  these two are captured by redcoats.  The redcoats don't care about info, instead use fear and illusion magics to condition their brains to be terrified of redcoats.  They will be allowed to roleplay in here, and you are welcome to come up with creative "interrogation" tactics
Eliza comes to and shakes her head
Vivica's head is pounding and she blinks awake
(Dm's please hit us with your most gruesome stuff. I wanna read some fun stuff tonight)
(I'm down for it too)

A red coat walks into the room, have they seen this man before? He looks familiar. He turns away for a moment and his face seems to change. Is this Finn or Bo? Wait... no neither of them would have such a sinister smile, yet that familiar feeling lingers.  Eliza eyes him trying to focus on the feeling. Her eyes burn and her vision goes white. Vivica can see tears streaming freely down her face yet Eliza won't look away. Vivica tries to speak, to call out to her friend but she is stopped by a crushing weight on her chest. She slumps back against the wall, the chains on her wrists unwilling to let her fall back completely. The weight is soul crushing, she thinks her ribs are snapping. The burning of Eliza eyes spread to her skull, why can't she blink? Look away. Is someone else in the room? Just barely past her pain, she hears someone struggling to breathe.
<@430898830498725888>
You still feel as though you are being watched.

The room is empty, the only sound heard is small moans of pain coming from the two elven women chained to the back wall. Eliza blinks her eyes several times but the tears still refuse to stop. Through blurry eyes she sees Vivica. Her breathing still raged but an improvement from what she heard earlier. Vivica shudders, the chains bound to her shaking violently. "They're watching us." She gasps out. "I can feel it. They've been watching for days." She sounds slightly deranged.  Eliza looks around and sees nothing "Vivica?" Her voice is just barely a whisper. She turns her head to the Eladrin "How else would they have known. They were ready for us." She begins to shake again. Eliza's eyes search the room, even with darkvision she sees nothing. "How?" She asks to no one in particular.
<@430898830498725888>

The lighting is irregular and harsh, the meals are small scraps at irregular times. You try to keep time, but it is impossible. The room slopes towards where you are chained, so any waste flows towards you. There is a faint droning sound that refuses to let up or fade into the background. Any redcoats that come in seem to care less about getting information and more about causing pain, of which there is plenty.

You each have this series of events play out over and over... a redcoat walks up to you, his mouth turns into a gaping maw.  Roaches crawl from empty eye sockets.  His skin bubbling as if boiling water.  As he breathes in, you feel as if 1 layer of your mind has been removed.  You are certain that he must have took something, but no matter how hard you try, what you thought was there seems missing, but everything you remember is still there.  What did he eat.  When his maw closes, he begins to walk away, before he turns around, and walks up to you, his mouth turns into a gaping maw.... 

How many times did you live that?  How much time has passed?  Will you ever escape? Wait... was it hope he stole.... or are you just feeling hopeless?  who knows?
(darn, that was gonna be close to something I was thinking)

There's no telling what's worse, the images they see, or the pain. Perhaps its simply them, those monsters drapped in red. Those monsters, masters of pain who have constructed a new reality. For all they know, they are the only ones left. One of them said their allies were gone. That they chased them down, hunted and killed them all. They are just keeping us here for fun now. How long have we been in here? There's a sound of crying, whoes? Is this screaming me? I can't move, why can't I move? Who are these devils in red. Why am I here? I want to leave... I want it to end.

You see what appears to be a young adult girl, no older than 18.  she may have been pretty once, but the scars from the burns will never heal.

A one clawed lobster of a man injects a silvery liquid into her arm.  You watch as the screams, and her veins become a pulsing red.  Right when she passes out, and her veins are back and charred, the lobster forces a little berry in her mouth.  Every time she passes out, he revives her, laughing as you are forced to watch.

The feeling of being watched lies heavy on Vivica and her muttering of it hasn't stopped. Eliza has resulted to tuning her out, focusing inward to her physical pain in order to avoid hearing Vivica delusions. Her futile attempt of peace is met with a crashing sound and a monstrous grin from a soldier clad in red.
A red cloaked woman passes by the interrogation room
Eliza tenses up
Vivica's eyes go wide, she knows she seen the figure before

The two elves struggle to keep their eyes open, exhaustion gripping them. Rest isn't an option. They have been coming in and out several times now. They can't tell how long the intervals are, pain, flickering lights, and illusions have warped their sense of reality. Any sound that isn't the rattle of chains or the voices of the two friends makes them jump. The shadows play tricks on them, in every conner of the room a redcoat sits. Watching. Every movement. Every sound. A threat to them. They try to huddle together but their bindings prevent them from even getting within inches of each other. Nothing seems to aproch them, but the figures in the shadows, marked with red, lie in wait.

What feels like years, but only simply hours pass. Another redcoat enters, but this one feels different, this redcoat doesn't have any body to show, it's just a black figure with bright white eyes and a fully visible mouth. The uniform unchanged, but the red feels... Redder. One candle goes out, then another, and another. Until the face is all that shows, but it keeps growing wider, beyond a normal person's smile. The smile then does a large scream so piercing, it feels like a spear is running through you. You look down and there is a spear right at your chest, just floating there. But with only a few seconds passing, the spear starts inserting it's head into your chest. The pain is feels like a sharp... burning. All you can do is scream, but the spear doesn't stop, it continues going deeper for literal minutes. The pain never lightens up.
( <@!361351593292988425>  do a intelligence check)
(Riiip)
An ominous figure peers in. Waits a moment and then leaves.
(well, not much better)
(actually, any tiggers I should know about before my imagination goes wild?)

Vivica looks down and feels the spear still there, it doesn't feel like it has moved anymore, but just stays in one spot. The pain still burns, but it doesn't feel as bad as it felt a second ago. You manage to stop screaming and take two breaths until the shadow man puts your chin up so you both can stare at each other. The shadow man has bleeding eyes and his hand feels slimy, but as if it's moving. Like it's a bunch of worms or slimy snakes. You watch as the face looked like nothing ealier, but as you blink, it becomes Eliza. Blink again, it becomes Finn, Blink, Willow. It goes through everyone you know, screaming in pain and bleeding from the eyes, until you try to close your eyes for good, but you open then after the screaming stops and it's your face. It starts laughing at you as if it's everyone you just saw laughing at you. It lets go and backs up. You see everyone you just saw but now on a post being held up by the spear in their gut. your face on this shadow figure morphs into something very close to you, but with a longer mid second. Allowing it to get to the height of the people hanging. Everyone is screaming in pain and you watch as your self starts slicing one. Then you watch as it slowly moves to Eliza, stopping their screams. Then to Finn, then to Willow, then to Nolan, your parents, the people you knew in Europe. Until the final scream stops. You just see everyone hanging limp. All you are able to do is cry and scream. Within a blink, everything stops and you think you still feel the spear in your gut. Eliza looking a little better then you are, but still panting.
(swear I'm an okay person...)
(We're all dark and twisted, its fine)

The room is spinning. Everytime they think they will finally slip into a unconsciousness even for a second, a bitter and sour berry gets shoved into their mouths. The micro second of bliss gets ripped away from them by a hand sticking their fingers into their mouth to keep them alive.  The room won't stop spinning. There is laughter in their ears and the men in red take turns coming up with ways to cause them more pain. To bring them inches from their lives just to force the berry into their face again. The room is spinning.

The ringing in her ears begins to recede. Vivica looks up, and sees Eliza is slumped against the wall staring at the ceiling a few feet away.  She shakes her head. In the far corner of the room she sees a small figure curled up. It's a young Vivica,  small, only a child. She's crying for her parents. Begging them not to immigrate here. Vivica's chest tightens "If they had listened I wouldn't be here." a tear drips down her face. "I want to go home again" she says aloud, thinking of France.  The child lifts her face, her eyes are blackened holes that stare directly into Vivica's eyes. She brings her knees to her chest and sobs feeling as small as her child self. 
"Home?" Eliza's gaze sweeps across the room as she echos Vivica. She sees her younger self, back to her. Elizas reminded of those days back in FerryTown. She gets flashes of images, dreaming of standing up against the redcoats, wanting to protect others. "Look where those dreams got me." She thinks. Her eyes shift to Vivica whos sobbing. "I wish I could go back. Its not far from here." She too begins to cry. She watches her younger self slip away into the nothing. A feeling she wishes she could mimic in this moment.
(Ok last one for tonight, these are so fun to write and I love working with Eliza on them.)

You know that feeling that something is behind you, about to touch your skin?  That feeling that its just inches away about to do harm?  Breathing down the back of your neck?  You can see it out of the corner of your eyes, but when you turn your head, it moves behind you never letting itself be seen?  You know that feeling?  You spend an hour seeing fine, but you have that sensation.

Vivica watches herself walk into the room, she thinks its herself, she's in a red coat. Its her body but the eyes aren't quite right. She watches herself, taking Eliza from her place on the wall and strap her to the center of the floor. She watches herself whisper something into Elizas ear, she is calm but then her body jerks, a scream can't even be heard for her breath is gone... Vivica blinks, now she is in the center of the floor, watching the twisted version of herself. Her breathe is gone, her lungs are squeezing, her ribs constricting. As her body jerks and she kneels, dipping her head to the ground she sees herself. Chained to the wall watching in horror. She blinks... Vivica watches from the wall as Eliza catches her breath and screams "Where is Eliza? Bring her back!!"

You are becoming more lucid.  Your heads are clearing up.  Then some red coats come out in front of you.  Some seem to be your friends, others you don't recognize.  The moment you see those red suits, you want to vomit, run, and hide all at the same time.  You think that they must be making you still feel terror, but just a moment ago, you felt so free of their enchantments.
In the middle of being interrogated, a small sense of clarity hits Eliza. "I... I forgot to find essence..."
she then passes out for a couple of mins
Vivica turns her head to Eliza "I don't think we'll find anything here." She says warily
"I.... Need.... More.... Essnceeeeeeeeeee" She wales, and then passes out again
*The closet door creeeks open.*
Vivicas eyes look fearful
Eliza looks intensely
*A Phantasmal hand is slowly approaching you...*
Vivica presses herself against the wall trying to avoid it but her chains make this difficult.
Eliza just stares, waiting for what happens. If it's more pain, no point in fighting
(just seeing where I am mentally)
